title: The Rise of Agentic AI in Enterprise Data Workflows: A Systematic Review of Architectures, Applications, and Research Challenges
content: The emergence of Agentic AI, conceptualised here as autonomous virtual robots, signals a shift toward software systems capable of independent reasoning, strategic planning, and executing complex work-flows. Traditional data pipeline management, orchestration, governance, and compliance processes remain largely manual or rule-based, resulting in high operational costs, latency, scalability issues, and compliance risks. This systematic review examines the current state of research on the application of Agentic AI to enterprise data workflows. A comprehensive search was conducted across major academic databases, yielding 860 unique records after duplicate removal. Following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, 30 relevant papers published between 2024 and 2026 were selected for full-text screening based on predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria. Data were systematically extracted using a standardised form focusing on Agentic AI architectures, targeted data workflows, technologies employed, evaluation methods, results, limitations, and future directions. The review reveals that Agentic AI is primarily applied in areas such as automated compliance enforcement, intelligent pipeline orchestration, self-healing data systems, governance, and provenance tracking. Promising architectures combining multi-agent systems with Retrieval-Augmented Generation demonstrate capabilities in real-time risk detection, autonomous remediation, and audit logging. However, the majority of studies remain at the conceptual or prototype stage, with limited empirical evidence from large-scale production deployments. Critical research gaps identified include insufficient real-world validation, challenges in legacy system integration, a lack of comprehensive governance and observability frameworks, the absence of standardised benchmarks, and limited analysis of economic impact and human-AI collaboration. This systematic review synthesises current advancements while highlighting the urgent need for production-ready implementations and robust evaluation methodologies. The findings provide valuable insights for researchers and practitioners aiming to harness Agentic AI for more autonomous, resilient, and compliant enterprise data workflows.
